entries.21baf299a292dc9d: Built on three basic strategies (personnel strategy, brand strategy and growth strategy), it aims to establish a sound management foundation through improved profitability and sustainable growth. Under the personnel strategy, it will pursue wage increases, improvements to personnel systems and digitalization of operations; under the brand strategy, it will aim to establish its brand and expand its customer base through high-value-added products and services; and under the growth strategy, it plans to renovate guest rooms in the main building, expand investment in its external sales business "S.Weil", and lay the groundwork for the 100th anniversary of its opening in 2027.
